case: Custom enum metadata, keyed edit and filter with quoted identifiers
contract: A schema named Enum Shelf, enum type State Kind and table Row Box are discovered as exact qualified metadata.
The generated keyed update stores paused with the exact quoted pg_typeof result and leaves the sibling row and its enum value unchanged.
A structured equality filter over the fetched metadata selects the updated target row with the same exact native type.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --package tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration enum_contract::value_contract_custom_enum_quoted_identifiers_support_keyed_edit_and_filter -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --package tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Identifiers containing embedded quote characters and additional search_path/session combinations remain open; this case does not close the PostgreSQL enum configuration matrix.
